mapper.select: /* comment.selectCommentList */ SELECT c.comment_id, c.board_type, c.board_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.user_id, c.user_name, c.content, c.del_yn, c.crt_date, c.mdf_date, c.crt_user_id, c.mdf_user_id, COALESCE(up.cnt, 0) AS recommend_count, COALESCE(dn.cnt, 0) AS not_recommend_count, mv.vote_type AS my_vote FROM board_comment c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT comment_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM board_comment_vote WHERE vote_type = 'UP' GROUP BY comment_id ) up ON up.comment_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT comment_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM board_comment_vote WHERE vote_type = 'DOWN' GROUP BY comment_id ) dn ON dn.comment_id = c.comment_id LEFT JOIN board_comment_vote mv ON mv.comment_id = c.comment_id AND #{sess_user_id} IS NOT NULL AND mv.user_id = #{sess_user_id} WHERE c.board_type = #{board_type} AND c.board_id = cast(#{board_id} as varchar) AND c.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.parent_comment_id IS NULL THEN c.crt_date END ASC, c.parent_comment_id ASC, c.crt_date ASC

SELECT c.comment_id, c.board_type, c.board_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.user_id, c.user_name, c.content, c.del_yn, c.crt_date, c.mdf_date, c.crt_user_id, c.mdf_user_id FROM board_comment c WHERE c.comment_id = #{comment_id} AND c.del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comment ( comment_id, board_type, board_id, parent_comment_id, user_id, user_name, content, del_yn, crt_date, mdf_date, crt_user_id, mdf_user_id ) VALUES ( #{comment_id}, #{board_type}, cast(#{board_id} as varchar), #{parent_comment_id}, #{sess_user_id}, (SELECT user_nm FROM SYS_USER WHERE user_id = #{sess_user_id}), #{content}, COALESCE(#{del_yn}, 'N'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{sess_user_id}, #{sess_user_id} )

/* comment.insertCommentVote */ INSERT INTO board_comment_vote ( comment_id, user_id, vote_type, crt_date, upt_date ) VALUES ( #{comment_id}, #{sess_user_id}, #{vote_type}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
